learning_objective: 🎯 We will revise our ABCs, learn about magic vowels, and put words in the correct ABC order!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet family. We can write them as BIG capital letters like A B C and small letters like a b c.
There are 5 very special letters called Vowels. They are A E I O and U! They help make the sound of every word.
The other 21 letters are called Consonants. Letters like B C D and Z are all consonants. They are best friends with vowels!
ABC order means putting words in the same line as the alphabet. Apple comes before Ball because A comes before B!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Vowel Hand Magic
fun_activity.instructions: Trace your hand on a piece of paper. Write one magic vowel A E I O U on each finger and color them brightly!

quick_recap: ⭐ The English alphabet has 26 letters in total.
⭐ A E I O and U are the 5 magic vowels.
⭐ Putting words in ABC order means sorting them from A to Z.
